title: Q-YEAR-second-clock: add a clock that needs neither Cron Triggers nor GitHub's scheduler
body:
**Owner:** staff
**Trigger:** UNATTENDED-365 register, dependency `second-clock` is open
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation unattended --probe second-clock
**Status:** open

Give the tenants Durable Object (or a new one) an alarm that re-arms itself every 10 minutes and calls the tick through its service binding when the newest tick beat is late; record the beats in loop_beats and add the clock to doctrine/clocks.json.
When it holds, set the dependency's status to closed in doctrine/unattended.json with the evidence and a probe that resolves.
